top.notificationsLater: Notifications arrive in a later phase

landing.title: The working record of a scientific meeting.
landing.lede: ScholarFlow is being built for authors, reviewers, and conference committees. This installation is the foundation: a conference-ready interface, a secured API shell, and a live health check. Manuscripts, reviews, and decisions are not available yet.

authors.title: Authors
authors.body: Submissions, revisions, camera-ready files, and copyright steps will live in one paper workspace.

reviewers.title: Reviewers
reviewers.body: Assignments stay limited to invited papers, with separate comments for authors and the committee.

committees.title: Committees
committees.body: Chairs and administrators will share a conference, with scientific decisions kept apart from office administration.

health.title: API status
health.degraded: API is up. The database is not reachable
health.hint: Start PostgreSQL and the API, then refresh this page.

workspace.banner: Conferences, submissions, and review assignments are live. Review forms and decisions are not connected yet.
workspace.notAuthenticated: This control does not grant access.

dashboard.emptyBody: This list stays empty until the corresponding workflow is implemented.
dashboard.chartEmpty: Charts will use conference statistics from Phase 13. No sample series is shown.

author.title: Author workspace
author.intro: A place for your manuscripts, revision requests, and publication tasks. The counters below are not live.

reviewer.title: Reviewer workspace
reviewer.intro: Assigned papers, invitations, and review deadlines will appear here. No papers are assigned in this preview.

committee.title: Scientific committee
committee.intro: Track chairs and program chairs will monitor reviews and record decisions here. Decision authority is not active.

administrator.title: Conference administration
administrator.intro: Conference setup, memberships, and document checks will be managed here, separately from scientific decisions.

system.title: Platform administration
system.intro: System-wide configuration will be limited, separate from any one conference, and audited. It is not available in this phase.

planned.title: This module is not available yet
planned.body: The page is reserved so the navigation matches the product. It does not pretend to load or save conference data.
planned.unknown: This address is not part of the workspace.

preferences.title: Interface preferences
preferences.intro: These choices are stored in this browser only. They do not create an account.

notFound.title: This page is not part of ScholarFlow
notFound.body: The address does not match a foundation screen.

auth.loginIntro: Use a verified ScholarFlow email. Local demo accounts all use the password Demo-scholar-12.
auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters, with a letter and a number.
auth.forgotBody: If an account exists for this address, a one-time link will be sent.
auth.forgotSent: If an account exists, a reset message has been sent.
auth.checkEmailBody: The account stays closed until you open the verification link. On this local install the message is in Mailpit, not in Gmail.
auth.verifyDone: Your email is verified. You can sign in.
auth.verifyMissing: This page needs a verification link.
auth.photoLater: Profile photos will be stored in private object storage in a later update. There is no upload control yet.

conferences.directoryIntro: Published conferences that chose to be listed. Drafts and unlisted meetings are not shown.
conferences.directoryEmpty: No published conferences are listed yet.
conferences.title: Your conferences
conferences.intro: Open a conference you belong to. Only the superadmin creates a conference and chooses its admin.
conferences.empty: You do not belong to a conference yet.
conferences.name: Conference name
conferences.noTemplates: No templates yet. These texts are stored for later notifications. They are not sent by themselves.
conferences.subject: Subject
conferences.inviteHint: The admin (or sub-admin) invites authors, reviewers, and committee members. Sub-admins are created with the dedicated credentials form instead.

createdBy.reviewer: Reviewer: created by the admin / sub-admin via this invitation.
createdBy.committee: Committee: created by the admin / sub-admin via this invitation (decisions, scope, follow-up).
createdBy.author: Author: created by the admin / sub-admin via this invitation, or by joining the conference.
createdBy.subAdmin: Sub-admin: created only by the admin (credentials form above).

conferences.invitationHint: The person accepts from their conference list.
conferences.filesAfterAcceptance: Files and the similarity score open after a published acceptance.
conferences.invitationBody: Accepting adds you to the conference with the role in the invitation. The link works once.
conferences.invitationMissing: This page needs an invitation link.
conferences.loadError: The conference list could not be loaded.

registrationPage.title: Registration and payment
registrationPage.intro: Accepted papers appear here. Registration and payment happen in this menu, not in the paper workflow.
registrationPage.empty: No accepted papers yet. Registration opens after an Accepted decision.

followUp.title: Publication
followUp.intro: Only published papers: step 9 “Final decision and publication” completed (DOI assigned). Papers still waiting stay in Submissions.
followUp.empty: No published papers yet. Drafts and pre-publication work stay in Submissions.

papers.title: Submissions
papers.intro: Deposit and workflow until publication: draft, PDF, submit, review, camera ready. Already published papers (DOI) are in Publication.
papers.depositEditorHint: Details, authors, PDF file, then submit.
papers.authorsHint: Add authors and the corresponding author.
papers.formNote: These four pills only file the manuscript. The ten round steps are in the list above.
papers.needDraft: Save the draft in Details first. The file is uploaded on the Manuscript step.
papers.fileHint: PDF only, up to 20 MB. The file stays in private storage.
papers.submitHint: Submitting freezes the manuscript. Withdrawal is the only later change in this phase.
papers.failed: The submission could not be saved.

reviews.title: Review invitations
reviews.intro: Accept a review, then send a score from 1 to 10 and comments. Committee notes stay hidden from authors.
reviews.formOnReviewsPage: The full form (score, confidence, comments) is on the Reviews page.
reviews.assignIntro: Only submitted papers can be assigned. A conflict of interest or an existing active assignment is rejected.
reviews.assignDashboardHint: After scope acceptance, assign reviewers by paper, author, or reviewer.

sessionChair.intro: Follow the presentations assigned to you: schedule, modality, then mark Presented with remarks for the author.
sessionChair.queueHint: Validate after the talk and leave remarks for the author.
sessionChair.empty: No presentation is assigned to you as session chair yet.

workflow.similarityLocal: Upload the report PDF, then enter the percentage it shows. The admin checks that it stays under 20%. The figure is stored here, without an outside service.
workflow.noSessions: This conference has no sessions yet.
workflow.feeDue: This conference asks for a local payment. Confirm it after registering, before it can be approved.

home.empty: Nothing here yet. Open Submissions to start a draft.
home.chairIntro: Steer papers, reviews, and decisions for the conference.
home.committeeIntro: Committee member: scope, reviewer assignment, decisions, and stage follow-up. Created by the admin via an invitation.
home.chairBoardHint: Filter by stage, then open the dossier to act.
home.reviewerIntro: Accept invitations, read the manuscript, then send your review. Created by the admin via an invitation.
home.reviewBoardHint: Open a card to accept or continue a review.
home.joinBody: A new account has no papers until you join a conference.

submission.pending: The draft has not been submitted.

presentation.pending: The talk is not on the program yet.
presentation.failed: The talk is not on the program yet.

editable.pending: The editable final version is missing.
editable.failed: The editable final version is missing.

template.pending: The template has not been checked.
template.failed: The template has not been checked.

similarity.pending: The similarity report is not verified.

copyright.pending: The copyright form has not been filed.

home.noConference: You are not in a conference yet.
home.chairEmpty: This conference has no papers yet.

errors.verifyEmail: Confirm your email before signing in. On this local install, open the link in Mailpit.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
errors.alreadyMember: You are already a member of this conference.
errors.tooMany: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.csrf: The secure request could not be prepared. Reload the page.
errors.decision: Only a submitted paper can receive a decision.
errors.similarityHigh: 20 percent is not under the threshold.
errors.similarityFile: Upload the similarity report before verification.
errors.notReady: The paper is not ready to publish yet.
errors.noPayment: This conference does not ask for a payment.
errors.unpaid: The registration fee is still unpaid.
errors.schedule: Only an accepted paper can be scheduled.
errors.superadminOnly: Only the superadmin can create a conference.
errors.conferencePasswordMissing: The superadmin has not set a password for this conference yet.
errors.subAdminOnly: Only the conference admin can create a sub-admin.
errors.draftOnly: Only a draft conference can be deleted.
errors.userHasPapers: Disable this account instead. It still owns papers.
errors.removePapersFirst: Remove the papers before deleting this draft.

superadmin.title: Dashboard
superadmin.intro: Platform overview. Use the sidebar to open each section.
superadmin.sectionIntroAdmins: Create admins and keep their sign-in passwords.
superadmin.sectionIntroConferences: Create, publish, clone, or delete a draft conference.
superadmin.sectionIntroUsers: Disable, verify email, or sign a account out.
superadmin.overviewAdmins: Create admins, keep their passwords, and reset them.
superadmin.overviewConferences: Publish a conference, assign the admin, and change its status.
superadmin.overviewUsers: Browse researchers, reviewers, and admins on the platform.
superadmin.overviewAudit: Who created an admin, changed a status, disabled an account…
superadmin.overviewSessions: See active sessions and sign a account out.
superadmin.loginPasswordHint: This password is for the admin sign-in. It stays visible here so you can pass it on.
superadmin.adminCreated: Admin account created for {{email}}. The sign-in password is shown in the list.
superadmin.conferenceCreated: Conference published. The admin will find it after signing in and enter the conference password.
superadmin.conferencePasswordHint: The admin enters this password after signing in to open the conference. It stays visible in the list.
superadmin.passwordSaved: Password saved for {{name}}. The conference is published.
superadmin.manageConferenceIntro: Password, assigned admin, status, clone, or delete.
superadmin.usersIntro: Disable, delete, force email verification, or sign a account out.
superadmin.auditIntro: Recent platform actions: admin creation, status, sessions, accounts…
superadmin.sessionsIntro: Revoke one session or every session for an account.

access.title: Choose a conference
access.intro: The first time, choose the conference and enter its password. Later sign-ins open it directly.
access.remembered: The password for this conference is already saved.
access.empty: No published conference is assigned to you yet.
access.subAdminHint: The sub-admin signs in with these details, chooses this conference, and enters the same conference password.
access.subAdminCreated: Sub-admin created. This person can sign in right away.

dossier.fileUnavailable: Preview unavailable — file storage may be stopped.
dossier.fileOpenHint: This file type opens as a download.
dossier.similarityPercentHint: Enter the percentage shown on the report (< 20%).
dossier.myReviewHint: Accept the invitation, then send your review.
dossier.assignReviewerHint: Choose a reviewer for this paper.
dossier.revisionHint: Upload the new version according to the remarks checklist.
dossier.paymentHint: Receipt or payment proof (PDF or image).
dossier.evolutionHint: Status of the submission from the first step through to publication.
dossier.finalReadyForPublication: Your paper is ready for submission to publication
dossier.finalCongratsBody: Every step is complete. Your paper is ready for publication.
dossier.finalWaitingAdmin: The admin assigns the DOI and publishes the paper.
dossier.noId: Assigned when the paper is submitted
dossier.scopePending: The admin checks that the subject matches a track.
dossier.scopeAccepted: Scope accepted. The paper moves to review.
dossier.scopeRefuseReasonHint: Explain why the paper is not accepted. Authors will see this reason.
dossier.reviewGoesToAuthor: The reviewer's advice goes straight to the author. The admin can only change it here.
dossier.registrationSentLine: The author registered. The admin confirms it here.
dossier.keep: Accepted without changes. The author keeps this paper.
dossier.openForRegistrationLine: Registration and payment are now open in the sidebar menu.
dossier.registrationSidebarHint: Complete registration and payment from Registration and payment in the menu.
dossier.adminPublishes: The admin publishes the paper on this step.
dossier.withChanges: Accepted with modifications. The author sends a revised version.
dossier.remarksHintAuthor: Address each remark, then upload a new version. The loop continues until every remark is validated.
dossier.remarksHintManager: Validate each remark once the fix is checked. When all are validated, the paper becomes Accepted.
dossier.paymentWait: Payment sent. The admin checks the receipt.
dossier.underCheckReceiptHint: The receipt was uploaded. The admin checks and validates the payment.
dossier.underCheckReceiptWaiting: Waiting for the admin to validate the receipt.
dossier.paymentUploadHint: Upload the receipt: status switches automatically to Under check receipt.
dossier.paymentValidatedHint: The admin validated the author's payment for this paper.
dossier.paymentDone: Registered. Certificate of acceptance and receipt are available.
dossier.pptWait: Not presented. The author sends the PowerPoint.
dossier.presentationHint: After registration and payment, the author uploads the PowerPoint. The admin validates or requests modifications.
dossier.scheduleHint: Date, time, room, session, modality and session chair.
dossier.chairFollowUpHint: Validate the live presentation and leave remarks for the author.
dossier.presentationReviewHint: Validate the presentation, or request modifications with remarks.
dossier.presentationNoteHint: One remark per line for the author checklist.
dossier.slidesModsHint: Upload a new version from the checklist. Status becomes Presentation will deposer.
dossier.slidesRemarksHintAuthor: Address each remark, then upload a new PPT version.
dossier.slidesRemarksHintManager: Validate each remark. When all are validated and the PPT is redeposited, the presentation can be accepted.
dossier.cameraHint: After presentation validation, upload the final PDF and Word/ZIP. The admin validates or requests modifications.
dossier.cameraReviewHint: Validate the final version, or request modifications with remarks.
dossier.cameraNoteHint: One remark per line for the author checklist.
dossier.cameraModsHint: Upload a new version from the checklist. Status becomes Camera ready will deposer.
dossier.cameraRemarksHintAuthor: Address each remark, then re-upload PDF and Word/ZIP.
dossier.cameraRemarksHintManager: Validate each remark. When all are validated and files are redeposited, the final version can be accepted.
dossier.cameraTemplateHint: The admin confirms the final PDF respects the template.
dossier.similarityStageHint: After camera-ready validation, upload the similarity report (< 20%). The admin then verifies it.
dossier.similarityReviewHint: Check the report and percentage, then validate.
dossier.copyrightStageHint: After similarity validation, upload the signed form. The admin then verifies it.
dossier.copyrightReviewHint: Check the uploaded form, then validate or refuse.
dossier.copyrightSteps: Download the form, sign it, then send it back.

footer.note: Development foundation. Do not use it for real manuscripts yet.
